# Data dictionary and analysis eligibility

Insert the governed data dictionary here. At minimum, document:

- person/test/report identifiers and repeat structure;
- referral indication and assay era;
- raw and normalized HBA/HBB findings;
- phase, copy state, evidence grade and unresolved alternatives;
- phenotype name, value, unit, collection date and treatment/transfusion context;
- missingness code and reason; and
- analysis-specific eligibility flags.

No direct identifiers or patient-level source reports belong in the repository.
